title: 1 Gallon (3.8L) OTTER Wet Look Concrete and Masonry Lacquer
description:
1 Gallon (3.8L) OTTER Wet Look Concrete and Masonry Lacquer
Wet Look is a crystal clear, high solid acrylic coating designed to protect and beautify concrete, masonry, and unglazed tile surfaces. This super tough film is formulated for interior and exterior applications. Walk on it, drive on it, it offers ultimate protection in a clear finish. Saturated with Otter Wet Look will actually harden old and deterioration mortar and plaster for added life.

Recommended Use

Exposed Aggregate, stamped concrete, porous brick, natural stone, slate, stucco, manufactured stone, pebble stone, and unglazed roof tile.

Specification/ Sheen

Appearance: Clear colorless.
Clean up : Lacquer thinner.
Dry time: 1 hour.

Special note:
- If required, to dilute with thinner at maximum 1:1, if it is too concentrated.
- Always test a small area of surface to verify absorption and appearance.
- NOT RECOMMENDED for glazed tile, marble, dense brick, dense slate or artificial slate.
- Do not use where hydrostatic pressures is possible and avoid paint in rainy day.

Application

Apply with a natural brush or low pressure/ airless sprayer (with metal or Teflon tip)..
2 coat applications are required, however more porous concrete or unglazed tile may require 3 coats..
Allow 1-3 hours between coats or until the surface is dry to touch..
Apply in temperature between 25°C to 28°C avoid using under direct sunlight or hot flooring..
Use only in well-ventilated areas..
Special formulated under ultimate weathering and U.V. light resistance of any coating system.

Benefits/Features

Non-yellowing, even in the harsh tropical sun..
Use indoors or outdoors..
Fast-drying and long-lasting..
Prevent staining high solids..
Strong resistance to efflorescence..
(Note: Not recommended for dense or pre-sealed surfaces such as glazed ceramic or quarry tile, marble or terrazzo. To apply on terra-cotta. 1st coat of “Wet Look” has to be diluted with quality thinner at 1:3 parts for better absorption. This is to eliminate peeling off problem)

Coverage: 100 to 120 sq.ft per liter or (9sqm to 11sqm) depending on the porosity of the surface.

Important: The product contains active xylene and petroleum distillates. Read the product label carefully or consult with dealer for more detailed preparation,
application and caution information
